articles.title: Bitcoin rises above $64,000 after Pakistan prime minister says Iran peace deal is near
articles.snippet: Bitcoin traded above $64,000 on Saturday, supported by its strongest ETF inflows in a month and growing optimism around geopolitical developments.

articles.title: Sam Bankman-Fried loses appeal to overturn 25-year prison sentence
articles.snippet: A federal appeals court upheld the former FTX chief’s conviction, while his bid for clemency from President Donald Trump appears to face steep political odds.

articles.title: Crypto Biz: SpaceX fuels tokenization’s next boom
articles.snippet: Tokenized RWAs surge despite crypto volatility, Kraken launches SpaceX IPO xStocks, prediction markets outpace onchain gambling and Sam Bankman-Fried seeks a Trump pardon.

articles.title: US Government Orders Anthropic to Pull Claude Fable, Mythos AI Models
articles.snippet: Anthropic pushed back against what it described as an overreach, saying the vulnerability cited is already widespread across the industry.

articles.title: GameStop Renews Bitcoin Deal That Did Little for Its Record Quarter
articles.snippet: The retailer rolled its Coinbase options deal forward in late May, keeping nearly all its Bitcoin tied up for upfront cash.
